concepts.name: picket
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: proposed Parcela app icon and website mascot. Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: the existing Parcela website, not an edit target. Match its quiet premium developer-tool personality: crisp geometry, rounded corners, restrained charcoal #171717, off-white #eeeDEA, deep sky blue #07668f. Make a single isolated large centered icon on a genuinely transparent background, square composition, 15% clear margin. Flat vector-like graphic, deliberate clean curves, strong silhouette readable at 24px. No text, lettering, watermark, mockup, presentation board, backdrop, ground shadow, gradients, glow, 3D, texture, hairlines, tiny decoration, generic robot, glossy AI blob, or app tile surrounding the icon. This is a new concept, not a copy of the reference page. Subject: THE PICKET, a complete redesign of Parcela's existing friendly fence-picket mascot (input image 2 is subject-reference only). Retain the pointed fence-post identity, but reinterpret it as a compact stout rounded pentagon with a broad low rooflike point, two small dark oval eyes, two tiny integrated rounded feet, and a single very short rounded arm lifted in greeting. It should feel like a highly designed symbol with a face, not a humanoid illustration. Body off-white with a clean medium-weight charcoal contour; one small deep-blue side/arm detail integrated into the silhouette. Simple confident pose, minimal forms, warm but composed, no motion marks. Do not repeat the old long pencil body, long skinny limbs or cobalt strokes.

This is a new concept, not a copy of the reference page. Subject: PLOT BUDDY, an original compact mascot representing a small private plot or workspace. A single friendly rounded square enclosure, slightly wider than tall, with its upper-right corner opening upward into one short rounded ear/tab; one solid bold continuous dark blue outer form encloses a generous off-white inset face with two small charcoal eyes.
